description: ABC Seamless is a U.S.-based home improvement and exterior construction company that specialises in custom on-site manufactured seamless steel siding, gutters, roofing and related exterior products for residential properties. Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Fargo, North Dakota, the company has grown into a recognised national brand with franchise operations and local service centres across many states. ABC Seamless manufactures products directly at customers’ homes using specialised equipment, which enables production of seamless steel siding and gutters that are designed to fit precisely without joints. This seamless approach is marketed as an innovation that enhances durability, reduces maintenance and improves protection from the elements compared with traditional sectional siding and gutter systems.

Wohnverbund St. Gertrud is a German social care and residential support organisation located in Morsbach, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. It operates as a non-profit residential network providing tailored living arrangements and support services for adults with intellectual and complex disabilities. The organisation manages multiple residential homes in the town centre, creating safe and structured living environments that go beyond basic accommodation to include social integration, skill development, personal care, community participation and leisure activities in areas like music, sport and culture. Residential units serve more than 120 adults, with specialised support adapted to individual needs and competencies, enabling residents to live as independently as possible while receiving necessary assistance.

IPU Industries Ltd. is a privately held Israeli industrial manufacturing company headquartered in Kiryat Gat, Israel, specialising in advanced plastic injection moulding and turnkey product solutions. Established in 1991, the company offers comprehensive design and production services — ranging from initial product design and mould engineering to injection moulding, assembly, quality control and final integration — all conducted under one roof. This end-to-end capability allows IPU to serve multiple sectors, including medical device manufacturing (diagnostic and surgical components), automotive parts, water-flow systems, consumer technology products and food-packaging components. Its facility features a clean room certified to medical-grade standards and a fully equipped in-house mould-making workshop, enabling both prototype and production tooling with rapid turnaround.

Greenhouse Apartments is a private residential real estate community and apartment complex located in the Greater Boston area of Massachusetts, with properties in Boston, Revere and nearby communities. The development is operated as a for-profit leasing and property management business that provides 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom rental units to urban professionals, families and students. Typical amenities found in the community include secure on-site management offices, fitness centres, resident lounges, rooftop decks, elevated outdoor spaces, bicycle storage and other convenience features designed to enhance urban living. Rents reflect the premium Boston housing market, with floor plan rates for larger apartments often in the higher end of the local rental spectrum.

RLC Transportes (operating under Rau Load Cargo, S.L.) is a Spanish logistics and freight-transport company based in El Puig de Santa Maria, Valencia. Founded in 1993, the company initially specialised in transporting fruits and vegetables but has since expanded into the import and export of all types of goods, with a notable focus on refrigerated transport for temperature-sensitive cargo such as food products. RLC has grown into one of Spain’s most experienced transport agencies, operating a modern fleet of over 300 trucks and maintaining multiple delegations across Spain and Italy (e.g., Valencia, Barcelona, Seville, Bologna), alongside a professional team of more than 100 logistics operators and multilingual traffic coordinators.

GS Global Resources (often abbreviated GSGR) is an American industrial engineering and machine-performance solutions company headquartered in Mukwonago, Wisconsin. Founded in 1972, the firm has grown from a component distributor into a technical partner for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that operate in heavy-industry and mobile-equipment markets. GSGR’s expertise spans hydraulic systems, electronic controls, mechanical integration and software applications, allowing it to design, engineer and deliver advanced integrated solutions that enhance the performance, control and reliability of machinery used in sectors such as agriculture, construction, mining, forestry and industrial automation. The company’s offerings include custom hydraulic assemblies, operator cab solutions, control systems, sensor integration, remote monitoring, valve and power units, and bespoke engineering to address complex machine-design challenges.

LC Publishing Group S.p.A. is an international digital publishing and information services company headquartered in Milan, Italy. Founded in 2011, the group focuses on producing 100% digital information and news content in specialised professional markets, particularly legal, tax, finance and food sectors from a business-oriented perspective. Its portfolio includes a network of digital titles such as Legalcommunity.it, Financecommunity.it, Inhousecommunity.it and Foodcommunity.it, along with English-language sites such as Legalcommunity.ch, portals oriented to Middle East and North Africa and Latin American legal publications like Iberian Lawyer and The Latin American Lawyer. The group also organises industry events, awards, conferences and workshops across countries including Brazil, Mexico, Spain, Portugal, Egypt, Switzerland and Italy, supporting professional networking and thought leadership within its core fields.

Tru-Line Manufacturing Company is an American industrial fabrication firm headquartered in Decatur, Alabama that specialises in the metal fabrication of precision hydraulic tube assemblies and structural tubing products for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). Founded in 1976, the company has over 40 years of operational history and has built a reputation for supplying high-quality metallic hydraulic tubing assemblies, custom powder coating services and engineered fabrication solutions to sectors such as construction equipment, agricultural machinery, mining vehicles and stationary industrial equipment. Tru-Line’s products contribute to the performance and longevity of heavy-duty machinery used in essential infrastructure, food production, transportation and resource extraction.

Superior Drywall is an established American commercial drywall contracting company based in Oxnard, California, specialising in a range of interior construction services for retail, commercial and institutional projects. With almost 40 years of experience in the drywall industry, the firm focuses on light-gauge metal framing, standard metal stud framing, insulation, drywall installation and related finishing work for new builds and renovations. The company prides itself on high standards of workmanship, personalised service, experienced site supervision and a strong commitment to safety, including dedicated safety personnel and third-party inspection for job sites.

Interr is a privately held security and risk-management services company headquartered at The Loom, 14 Gower’s Walk, London, UK. Established in 1998, the firm provides a wide range of protective and operational support services to businesses across the retail, hospitality, residential, corporate and event sectors in the United Kingdom, Europe and Asia. Interr’s core offerings include intelligent guarding, security officers, remote monitoring and response, reception and front-of-house staff, crisis management, investigations, security consultancy, safety training, and event security solutions tailored to complex organisational needs. The company also supports clients with bespoke compliance training, risk assessments and incident handling designed to enhance workplace safety, regulatory compliance and on-site resilience.

Based jewelry and accessories brand founded and led by designer Freida Rothman, who grew up in Brooklyn and comes from a family with deep roots in jewelry craftsmanship. The company specialises in luxury fashion jewelry — including bracelets, necklaces, rings, earrings — as well as accessories such as eyewear and handbags, all designed with a contemporary aesthetic that blends elegance and urban edge. The brand’s signature design elements often incorporate mixed metals, matte finishes and architectural influences, reflecting its founder’s inspiration from the New York City environment and her focus on creating pieces that evoke strength, resilience and everyday glamour. Freida Rothman’s collections are sold online at freidarothman.com and through a network of independent jewelry boutiques and leading department stores across the United States, and the brand has garnered recognition within the fashion accessory sector for its distinctive style and craftsmanship.

Is a Singapore-based accounting, auditing and bookkeeping services firm that has been operating as a registered partnership since 25 October 2006, according to the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) of Singapore. Its registered office is at 112 Robinson Road, Singapore, and the company specialises in financial services focused on accounting, auditing, taxation advisory and bookkeeping for small and medium-sized businesses in Singapore and potentially international clients as well.

Czech small-to-medium enterprise headquartered in Krnov – Pod Cvilínem, Czech Republic. The company specialises in the sale, repair and servicing of electric motors, pumps and power tools, and operates both as a service workshop and retailer of industrial maintenance equipment. Its product offerings include electric motors of various types, replacement parts and accessories, and it provides authorised repair and warranty services for several major tools and equipment brands — including FESTOOL, NAREX, BOSCH, MAKITA, DEWALT and Husqvarna — making it a one-stop partner for workshop and industrial tool needs. In addition to equipment repair, K R E S helps to equip workshops with tools and machines and produces traction electric motors for specialised applications.

Is a privately held Canadian construction and interior systems company headquartered in Ferme-Neuve, Québec with additional offices in Boisbriand (QC), Calgary (AB) and Ottawa (ON). Founded in 1999 by members of the Piché family, it evolved from a local firm into a national contractor specialising in interior systems and general contracting across institutional, commercial and industrial sectors. The company’s expertise includes steel stud framing, gypsum board installation, joint taping, insulation, soundproofing, project estimation and full construction project management services. It emphasises a family-oriented culture and professional project execution, which supports its delivery of large-scale construction work throughout Canada while maintaining quality and human-centred collaboration.

Since its founding in 1975, the company has built a reputation for manufacturing high-quality bedding made from virgin spruce and pine, tailored to the needs of equine, dairy, hog and poultry industries. Its product range — sold under brands such as OBEC’S Premium XLS, MS, SS and Pick O Bec — includes wood shavings with differing absorption levels, dust control and hygiene performance designed to support animal comfort, barn cleanliness and disease risk reduction in livestock environments. Rip-O-Bec also offers custom blends, wood pellets, rubber mats and peat moss under its agricultural product lineup, distributing both domestically in Canada and the United States and internationally in regions such as Europe, Asia and the Middle East.

The organisation was founded around 2000 and is headquartered in Fairy Meadow, New South Wales, with additional clinics located in Shellharbour, Parramatta, Bowral and other areas of New South Wales. The company focuses exclusively on orthodontics, providing services such as traditional metal braces, ceramic braces, lingual braces and clear aligner systems such as Invisalign, which are used to gradually reposition teeth and correct bite problems.

Its primary responsibility is to organise and manage municipal waste collection, recycling and disposal services for residents and businesses within the district. The organisation provides a comprehensive range of services including household waste collection, bulky waste (Sperrmüll) pickup, hazardous waste disposal, recycling centre operations, composting services and waste consulting. It also operates digital tools such as an online waste calendar and mobile app that help residents track collection schedules and manage their waste efficiently.

Genealogy SA, formally known as the South Australian Genealogy & Heraldry Society, is a leading Australian nonprofit organisation dedicated to family history and genealogical research. Founded in 1973, it has grown into the largest family history society in Australia, with over 4,300 members and a strong network of approximately 230 volunteers supporting its operations. Headquartered in Unley, South Australia, the organisation operates a specialised library and research centre that houses one of the most extensive collections of genealogical resources in the region, including books, microfiche, journals and archival materials, as well as access to more than 8 million digitised records.
